hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for tokenized stock pools that charges a per-pool fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at launch) split among the creator, a bid wall, and a platform treasury. It automatically manages a single-sided liquidity range (bid wall) below current price using accumulated fee revenue, and restricts liquidity additions to the factory until the pool graduates.
